properties.description: Reopened after user review of ad44c7a5. Partial improvements in aab6826d: folding uses the existing TypeScript syntax service independently of semantic project loading; engine catalog activation uses indexed edge lookup, preserving validation/atomic refresh. Recorded 20,000-edge contributor refresh improved from 8.2 seconds to 112 ms. Live file switching during pending semantics displays the second source in about 146 ms; its language lease delay fell from 6–10 seconds to about 1.2 seconds. Folding replies in 4–9 ms after opening. Remaining: first semantic analysis of the real RelationalEngine project still takes several seconds. Keep queued until cold semantic feedback is satisfactory; do not claim initial analysis is instantaneous. Regression tests cover held semantic responses, canceled obsolete acquisition and cold folding.
properties.title: Fix slow language support and unblock text-editor file switching
